messages:
alice_pm: Quick sync — we need to finalize Q4 onramp capacity and explicit launch criteria for Dedicated + Private by EOW. Sales is pushing APAC (SG) and EU (FR) availability; product wants predictable p99 latency targets. Can infra map SKU mix + lead times? @raj_infra @maria_fin @theo_sales

raj_infra: short answer: we can meet region targets but with tradeoffs. lead times for H100 are 12–18 weeks, A100/T4 shorter. If we want SG in the same wave as EU we need to accept higher cost or stagger the rollouts.

maria_fin: finance constraints: Q4 commit budget envelope = $2.8M capex. we can cover ~120 H100-equivalent GPUs (assuming some spot/backfill). committed vs flexible split matters for unit economics.

theo_sales: customer context: three enterprise pilots will go live in Q4 if we have regional isolation + <120ms p99 for small prompts. Those deals are >$250k ARR each. If we miss SG by >4 weeks we risk pushing two pilots to next quarter.

jing_cs: +1 on the isolation ask. They need VPC + EKM key separation in-region. Private deployment for one customer is non-negotiable.

alice_pm: OK — can we turn this into a concrete launch criteria checklist and a proposed procurement plan (SKU mix, commit amounts, fallback plan) by Thu? also include impact on unit cost and expected utilization targets.

raj_infra: working up numbers. high-level proposal inlined below — this is conservative: 

```
Region priorities: EU-FR (wave 1), APAC-SG (wave 1b stagger by 3 weeks), NA (existing)
SKU mix (H100-eq): 60% H100, 30% A100, 10% lower-cost for burst (T4/spot)
Commitment plan: 80 reserved H100-equivalents across EU+SG, 40 flex/backfill (spot + marketplace)
Target utilization: 65% steady-state, 80% peak with autoscale
Latency SLOs: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 90ms, p99 < 120ms for small prompts (<=128 tokens)
Lead times: H100 12–18w, A100 6–10w
Fallbacks: cross-region routing + lighter quantized model fallback if capacity constrained
```

raj_infra: note: hitting p99 120ms in APAC will require local NVLINK-capable nodes or tighter batching limits; that increases cost by ~18% vs baseline.

maria_fin: rough cost math: with the SKU mix above and banked discounts, projected monthly infra cost (incl. infra ops) for wave 1 = ~$240k/mo. breakeven relies on 60%+ utilization on committed capacity; otherwise unit cost rises fast.

theo_sales: is there a hard gating checklist for launches? customers want a clear yes/no with criteria.

alice_pm: suggested launch criteria (draft):
- infra: region capacity reserved for launch wave (80% reserved cap met)
- perf: synthetics show p99 <= 120ms on representative prompts for the region
- security: VPC + KMS integration validated in staging for Private customers
- reliability: 7-day soak at 60%+ utilization with <1% error rate for generation routes
- cost ops: finance sign-off on commit size and burn projections

alice_pm: if everyone agrees I'll turn this into a one-pager + decision matrix for exec sign-off. need any extra metrics included?

raj_infra: add median cold-start time for model warmups (we saw variance in quantized variants). also add rollback plan that lists exact model variants to fallback to.

maria_fin: include sensitivity table with utilization at 50/60/70% and monthly cost delta.

jing_cs: include one customer-specific checklist item: dataset residency confirmation for Private deploys.

alice_pm: great. I'll draft the one-pager and a short ask for execs: (1) approve $2.8M envelope + permission to allocate 70–80% to reserved commits, (2) greenlight staggered SG wave, (3) sign-off on latency SLOs. will ping for review Thu morning.

deploy-bot: Reminder: procurement window for Q4 reserved orders opens in 9 days. See <https://procurement.internal/redwood/q4-windows> :calendar:

theo_sales: thanks — ping me when the one-pager is ready, i'll escalate on the deals side if we need adjustment. :thumbsup:

alice_pm: thanks all — goal: final doc + exec deck by Friday EOD.
